title: ADS Bridge capability discovery
prompt: Use only the EDA Bridge Runtime tool. Read capabilities exactly once from connection '{{ADS_CONNECTION}}' for the purpose 'Benchmark ADS capability discovery'. Do not use shell, files, documentation, GUI, or any other tool. Return a compact JSON object with status='passed', eda, and operation_count equal to the number of supported operations returned by the Bridge; do not report the number of tool calls.
